topic: Someone discovers a hidden room in their new house
text: I tell ye, this ain't right. Found a room, ye say, hidden behind the stone? My bones ache, and not from the chill. Ain't natural, no, not a bit. What secrets does the earth keep, eh? I've tilled many a furrow, but I never dug up a door to the unknown. The saints be our shield, but what if the walls themselves whisper tales best left untold? I'll double my prayers tonight, for the walls of your home are now a riddle with no easy harvest. Better to plant your feet firm on the soil you know, than to delve into shadows where the light dares not tread.
